entry.title: Entry #862 in Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc., 3:23-cv-03417
entry.summary: ORDER. The Court has considered the concerns expressed by Meta's lead trial counsel about a potential trial conflict in the Western District of Washington, where she will be representing Amazon in a class action trial scheduled for June 2027. In an effort to alleviate the conflict, the trial date for the Entrepreneur Media case (and for any of the other individual cases, if Entrepreneur Media settles) will now be May 3, 2027 (rather than May 24, 2027). The pretrial conference will take place on April 20, 2027 at 1pm. The hearing on dispositive motions remains February 25. If Meta's lead trial counsel is concerned that this is still not enough time between the two trials, she should ask the Western District of Washington for a continuance of the June class action trial. If that request is denied, the Court apologizes, but this case is going to trial on May 3. Signed by Judge Vince Chhabria on 10/14/2026. (This is a text-only entry generated by the court. There is no document associated with this entry.)
